items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Money' only as a concept ('get a little money', 'Money was always...') in response to the interviewer's question about an interaction with a previously mentioned person (likely Lou Donaldson or another associate, but 'Money' itself is not a person).

ctx.x: So part of your interaction was he would want to get a little money.
Of course. Money was always... But he talked to me. We talked.
Did you ever sit in with him?
